issues.explanation: New mention validation, formatting, and truncation behavior ships with no Pest/PHPUnit test, violating TDD which requires a test for every feature.
CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] was not updated despite docs-freshness requiring it.
Integer config values are silently ignored via is_string check, while the task permits accepting an integer snowflake.
Regex uses \d instead of [0-9] for the ASCII-digits contract; safe in default PCRE but [0-9] would state the guarantee explicitly.

conventions.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:21-36 matches sibling mb_* style; config/services.php:49 and .env.example:9 use standard env wiring; docs updated in docs/ops/devops.md:61 and docs/ops/logging.md:73; but no test-first artifact and CHANGELOG.md untouched

readability.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:22-35: clear names mentionId/mention/maxForContent, small focused block, consistent with surrounding formatContent style

requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:24-35 trims then validates with '/^\d{17,20}$/' and emits '<@'.id.'>' on its own line; rejects @everyone/@here/abc/123/embedded newlines; reserves room via MaxContentLength - mb_strlen(mention) - 1; null/empty falls through to unchanged mb_substr at app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:38; wiring in config/services.php:49, .env.example:9, docs/ops/devops.md:61, docs/ops/logging.md:73

scope.evidence: 5 files touched (.env.example, DiscordOpsAlert.php, services.php, devops.md, logging.md), all directly serving the mention task; no unrelated refactor

security.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:25-28: trim + anchored '/^\d{17,20}$/' before concat '<@'.$mentionId.'>'; invalid values ignored silently with no mention; webhook/redaction paths untouched

simplicity.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:21-36: ~15 lines reusing existing $lines/implode/mb_substr flow, no new abstraction or duplication

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or Pest files; no coverage for valid/invalid IDs, empty setting, truncation survival, or no-op/redaction preservation

review.summary: Adds optional DISCORD_MENTION_ID ping with strict 17-20 digit validation and truncation-safe '<@id>' suffix plus env/config/docs wiring. Code logic meets the functional and security contract, but it ships with no tests and no CHANGELOG entry, so it needs changes before merging.
